rep.angle: lead with a peer company's result
rep.name: Leo

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Marcus, Leo from Hypersale, a fintech peer cut a ramp by 2 months, can I take 30 seconds to explain how?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Hey, Marcus here. You've got about twenty minutes. Go ahead, let’s hear your 30 seconds.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: They used AI buyer role-plays and quote-back scoring to expose coaching gaps weekly, not at quota time, what makes RAMP take seven months today.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: It’s a technical product. Reps stumble on integration questions during live calls. That slows them down.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: When reps stumble on integration questions, what happens to those opportunities, and how much of the seven-month ramp do you attribute to that?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Good question. Those opportunities slow down or stall out. I'd say that issue probably adds at least a couple of months to the ramp time.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: If integration gaps add two months, how many new AES face this annually, and what does each delayed month cost in pipeline or revenue?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: We bring on about five new AEs a year. Each delayed month could mean roughly tens of thousands in pipeline slipping, and that adds up fast.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: That's potentially hundreds of thousands in delayed pipeline annually. How do you currently prepare reps for integration questions, and where does that process break

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: We rely on manager-led roleplays and some documentation. The breakdown happens when real customer scenarios get more complex than the practice. How does your approach actually handle that?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: We turn your integration scenarios into adaptive buyer role plays, then score every response with the exact quote behind it, which scenarios derail reps most.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: The most common ones are around complex API integrations and custom data migrations. Those often trip reps up the most.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: When API and migration questions arise, what must reps diagnose versus escalate, and how much engineering or manager time does that consume weekly?
